notes.title: First-Ever 20% Discount! (feat. Chinese & Japanese Update)
notes.content:
Hello! This is ohkapi.

Finally! The long-awaited Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) and Japanese language support is here! 🎉
Now, even more global players can join the [b][i]quest to help a lifelong single simp survive the dating app jungle![/i][/b]

To celebrate this update, we're offering a [b][i]first-ever 20% discount![/i][/b]
[b][i]The biggest discount before the Steam Summer Sale![/i][/b]
Now’s the perfect time to level up your romance experience on a dating app!

Will this be the moment where the lifelong single simp finds salvation?
Only your advice can change his desperate fate.
A live-action dating sim where your choices matter!
[b][i]Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App[/i][/b]

[h2]🌼 Steam Spring Sale – First 20% Off! [/h2]
🔻 First discount since launch! The best deal before the summer sale!
📅 Sale period: [March 14~21]

[h2]🌍 Update Details [/h2]
✔ Official Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) and Japanese support
✔ Localized expressions → More natural and immersive dating app conversations!
✔ Now, Chinese & Japanese players can level up on the dating app too!

[h2]📱 UI & System Improvements [/h2]
✔ Improved text readability for different languages → Easier access for all players!
✔ Optimized conversation flow → More intuitive dating app interface!

[h2]🐞 Bug Fixes & Stability Enhancements [/h2]
✔ Smoother and faster matchmaking!
✔ Fixed minor bugs that disrupted immersion!

[h2]🔥[/h2]
[i][b]<Simp: Leveling Up on a Dating App>[/b][/i] is not just another dating sim.
In the fierce world of dating apps,
a romance-deprived lifelong single simp
must climb from the lowest Bronze tier to the elite Gold tier and survive!

[h2]📜[/h2]
He's getting older, yet he's never had a girlfriend.
His life is an endless cycle of work and home. He knows something has to change, but after work, he's always too exhausted to do anything.

[i]“Maybe I should try a blind date this weekend…?”[/i]

But there’s no one left to set him up.

[i]“Am I really going to be alone forever…?”[/i]

Then, one day, he comes across a dating app.

[i]“Maybe… this is my chance to finally start dating?”
“Before it’s too late, shouldn’t I at least try?”[/i]

Dating apps let you meet tons of people, fast.
But if you can't make an impression in just a few moments, your match is gone.

Will the lifelong single simp listen to your advice and level up on a dating app?

[h2]💡[/h2]
As this is a solo-developed game, I couldn't fit the entire story into one release.
But this journey is far from over—the next installment will dive even deeper.

[h2]🚀[/h2]
Future updates, discounts, and announcements will be shared via the Steam Community.
Add the game to your wishlist or follow to get the latest updates first!
Thank you for your support! 😊

notes.title: New Features and Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, it's ohkapi.

This update is packed with exciting new features, challenging achievements, and helpful improvements. Let's take a look:

[b]New Features[/b]
[*]Cinema Gallery
The Cinema Gallery is now here!  Rewatch all the videos you've unlocked in one convenient place. Easily revisit your favorite scenes or catch anything you might have missed. [i]Note: You need to complete the game once to unlock the Cinema Gallery.[/i]
[*]Puzzle Mode
A challenging new Puzzle Mode has been added for all you dating gurus!  This mode, originally designed for the game's launch, will test your skills as you decipher clues from your matches' conversations to earn points and climb the ranks to Gold Tier.


[b]New Achievements - 3 to Conquer![/b]
[*]RMT-Free Victory
"No cash, no cheats—just pure skill. Shouting for love without spending a cent."
[*]Master of Puzzle
"Trickier than playing hard to get, cracked the puzzle mode and became a true dating master."
[*]One Last Zombie Falls
"The final bullet—not for revenge, not for farewell, but for our love, eternal and undying."


[b]Improvements[/b]
[*]Gameplay
Improved "Revert Time map"
Added key prompt for "Revert Point" on dating app failures
[*]Achievements
Updated achievement icons
Adjusted character meeting requirements for achievements
[*]Visuals
Updated videos
[*]UI
Polished text and subtitles
Adjusted match profile tiers
[*]Bug Fixes
Various bug fixes


[b]Upcoming Updates[/b]
Simplified and Traditional Chinese language support


 This update is a true collaboration with the Steam Community, as it's directly based on the valuable feedback I've received. I'm so grateful for your insights and ideas, which are essential to making this game the best it can be. Thank you so much for your support and for playing! 😊

notes.title: [Update Notice] Difficulty Adjustment & Faster Gameplay Improvements
notes.content:
📌 Update Details
🚀 Faster Game System

Matching and result screens now process more quickly when paired with a rematched opponent.
Matching animations run more smoothly.
🎯 Difficulty Adjustment

Profile picture scores have been increased, making progression easier.
Match scores have also been adjusted for a more balanced experience.
⚡ Faster Progression Features

Mid-to-late game: Tesu Profile selection can now be reselected for quicker progress.
Improved button responsiveness for a smoother experience.

I’ll continue to refine the game based on your feedback. Thank you for your support! 😊
